rule: act_of(PanelArt, context): identical art, speaker and string; only the neighbouring occurrences and the knowledge state differ

occurrences.speaker: odette
occurrences.text: ET ÇA ?! C'EST TOI QUI L'AS LAISSÉ, CE MOT ?
occurrences.gloss: She produces the evidence and charges him: the note is presumed a lover's note he left or received.
occurrences.context: the note is a secret of HIS

occurrences.speaker: gustave
occurrences.text: MOI ?! TU CROIS QUE J'AI QUE ÇA À FAIRE ?
occurrences.gloss: Defensive denial: 'Me? You think I have time for that?' — a husband pleading busyness.
occurrences.context: he is the suspect, explaining himself

occurrences.speaker: odette
occurrences.gloss: She presses the interrogation: if not his, whose? She still controls the question.
occurrences.context: the author is unknown; she demands it

occurrences.speaker: gustave
occurrences.text: « À MA CHÈRE ODETTE... » TIENS. C'EST POUR TOI.
occurrences.gloss: He reads the address aloud and hands it back: the note was written TO her. The accuser is the addressee. The note's face turns to the reader on the bell.
occurrences.context: addressee known: Odette. Whoever wrote it is HER correspondent

occurrences.speaker: odette
occurrences.gloss: Now a flustered feint: she pretends not to know who would write to her — the same question as cover, asked too loudly.
occurrences.context: she is the suspect; the question is a dodge

occurrences.speaker: gustave
occurrences.text: MOI ?! TU CROIS QUE J'AI QUE ÇA À FAIRE ?
occurrences.gloss: Sarcasm: 'Me — write YOU love notes? You think I've nothing better to do?' The defence becomes a dig that also implies someone else did.
occurrences.context: he holds the evidence and the moral high ground

occurrences.speaker: odette
occurrences.text: ET ÇA ?! C'EST TOI QUI L'AS LAISSÉ, CE MOT ?
occurrences.gloss: A lame counter-attack: 'So YOU planted it? You left it there to trap me?' Same words, now an accusation of entrapment from the defensive side.
occurrences.context: she flails; leverage stays with him
